facts.fact: Pinned explicit PushT config uses planner MPCPlanner / sub_planner CEMPlanner, goal_H5, num_samples300, topk30, opt_steps30, max_iter30, n_evals50. README commands select plan_pusht.yaml for PushT baseline. CEM does not use action gradients.
Generic default plan.yaml separately selects planner gd. Must not mix generic GD path with explicit PushT CEM config.
README maps per_tensor to calib_mode_a layer_wise and per_token to token_wise. These activation paths differ in gradient contract, but that alone does not diagnose CEM failures.

consequence: Earlier conditional GD gradient observation is not established as cause of published PushT failures. Exact original experiment config/log provenance unavailable, overrides possible; remain source-scope only. No actual CPU/GPU/model/tensor/gradient test.
